svg.aria-label: End to end: Own product engineering end to end at a high-growth energy company. Lead management platform: Planned and built it, from data model to UI. Lead assignment is 3 to 4 times faster. Scoring engine: Built the scoring engine that matches leads to sellers. Infrastructure: Run the infrastructure on AWS and Azure, provisioned with Terraform. Release quality: Ship each release with unit, E2E and visual regression tests. Private code: The code is private. Case studies are on velimir-mueller.de (https://velimir-mueller.de)
